hook.say: A teardrop, an elephant, a letter S. These five countries all look like something. Can you name them?

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.fact: Sri Lanka: this teardrop-shaped island was called Ceylon until 1972.
questions.sayAnswer: Sri Lanka! This teardrop shaped island was called Ceylon until 1972.

questions.fact: Thailand: Thais often say their country is shaped like an elephant's head.
questions.sayAnswer: Thailand! Thais often say their country is shaped like an elephant's head.

questions.fact: Vietnam: roughly S-shaped, and only about 50 km wide at its narrowest.
questions.sayAnswer: Vietnam! It is roughly S shaped, and only about 50 kilometers wide at its narrowest.

questions.fact: Finland: its outline is known as the Maiden of Finland, a woman with a raised arm.
questions.sayAnswer: Finland! Its outline is known as the Maiden of Finland, a woman with a raised arm.

questions.fact: Croatia: shaped like a horseshoe, with more than 1,000 islands and islets.
questions.sayAnswer: Croatia! It is shaped like a horseshoe, with more than 1000 islands and islets.
